|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-82-Mon_Calamari_Dockyards-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Home One) may deploy –2 (to a maximum of –3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. Capital Support is canceled. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 26). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “are deploy -2” for “may deploy –2” (it writes the Immune to Alter icon as “(Immune to Alter.)”, which is notation only): “Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Home One) are deploy -2 (to a maximum of -3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. Capital Support is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1261_83-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
